# CellGradientType

public enum CellGradientType

Namespace `SharpCell` · package `SharpCell`

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="linear"></a>`Linear` | 0 | In a straight line at [CellGradient.Angle](SharpCell.CellGradient.md#angle). |
